question: Kanaka Raju, a veteran practitioner of which of the following folk dances, was conferred the Padma Shri in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gussadi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• **Kanaka Raju** 

 
 
• He performs Indian **gussadi dancer **.
 
• He received the **Padma Shri honour **from the Indian government in **2021 **for his **contributions to the arts.**
 
• Raju hails from the hamlet of **Marlawai **in the **Komaram Bheem Asifabad district's **Jainoor mandal.
 
• Gussadi dancing **lessons **have been **taught **by **Raju **for more than **40 years.**
 
• In **1981**, he again **participated **in the **Republic Day procession.**
 
• As of right now, he serves as the Kanaka Raju School of **Gussadi dance's chief dance master. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Oggu Katha: **

 
 
• **Oggu Katha**, also known as **Oggukatha**, is a popular folk song that honours and tells the legends of the **Hindu gods Mallana**, **Beerappa**, and **Yellamma**.
 
• The **Kuruma **(Kuruba) and **Yadava **groups, who dedicated themselves to singing ballads in worship of **Lord Shiva**, are where it first appeared.
 
 
 
• **Tholu Bommalata:**
 
 
• **​**The **shadow puppet theatre **practise known as** Tholu bommalata** originated in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Its performers are a member of a group of roving performers and peddlers who visit villages over the course of a year and offer to sing **ballads, read fortunes, sell amulets, display acrobatic skills, charm snakes, weave fishnets, tattoo locals, **and **fix pots.**
 
 
 
• **Lambadi:**
 
 
• **​**One of the languages used by the once nomadic **Banjara **people in India is called **Lambadi, Gor Boli, Banjara, Labanki, or Banjari.**
